app_info.subtitle: Create images and videos
app_info.description: Choose supported AI models to create images and videos from text, images or model-supported references in ChatGPT. Transfer motion from a video to an image, or combine an image and audio into a music video. Reuse files in your private Media.io drive, view paginated generation history and display finished results. View your connected account and existing credit balance in a card. Compare estimated credit costs when requested; generation uses existing credits and entitlements without requiring a separate price-confirmation step. Models and settings are limited to the current tool schemas. The app does not offer credit purchases, subscriptions or upgrades.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing credit balance and membership entitlements as data without rendering a card or changing account state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated user’s private Media.io account entitlements and balance.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not spend credits, change entitlements or remove account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Displays the connected account’s available nickname and email only inside the card, alongside existing balance and membership, without changing account state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated user’s private account without navigation links or publishing data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not initiate purchases, consume credits or modify entitlements.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves statuses and available output links for existing tasks, optionally waiting for a bounded period without changing the tasks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads generation tasks belonging to the authenticated user’s private Media.io account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not restart tasks, spend credits or change generated files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing task results and displays completed media or failure information in a card without changing the tasks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Displays the authenticated user’s private Media.io task results without publishing them.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create billable tasks, overwrite source files or delete results.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing generation history with optional filters and pagination as data without changing tasks or rendering a card.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches generation history only within the authenticated user’s private Media.io account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, cancel, delete or charge for generation tasks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Displays a page of existing tasks with current status, timestamps and available media immediately without waiting for completion or changing tasks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Displays the authenticated user’s private Media.io generation history without publishing it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, retry, cancel or delete tasks or consume generation credits.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists existing drive asset metadata and resolves file identifiers without changing stored files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches assets only in the authenticated user’s private Media.io drive.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not upload, overwrite, delete or generate media.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates estimated credit costs for a declared generation action and model-specific inputs without creating a task or reserving credits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calculates a quote for the authenticated Media.io account without publishing content or accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not deduct credits or start generation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an image generation task in the authenticated user’s private Media.io account from text using a selected declared model and its settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Submits a private Media.io image task without publishing results or accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Task creation can spend existing account credits while preserving existing files, and identical retries are deduplicated within the supported retry window.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an image generation task in the authenticated user’s private Media.io account from the selected model’s declared image inputs, prompt and settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes accessible Media.io source images and returns private results without publishing them or accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Task creation can spend existing account credits while preserving source images, and identical retries are deduplicated within the supported retry window.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a video generation task in the authenticated user’s private Media.io account from text using a selected declared model and its settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Submits a private Media.io video task without publishing results or accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Task creation can spend existing account credits while preserving existing files, and identical retries are deduplicated within the supported retry window.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a video generation task in the authenticated user’s private Media.io account using the selected model’s starting image and, where declared, ending image, prompt and settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes accessible Media.io source frames and returns private results without publishing them or accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Task creation can spend existing account credits while preserving source frames, and identical retries are deduplicated within the supported retry window.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a video generation task in the authenticated user’s private Media.io account from a prompt and the selected model’s declared image, video, audio or document references.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes accessible Media.io references and returns private results without publishing them or accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Task creation can spend existing account credits while preserving reference files, and identical retries are deduplicated within the supported retry window.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a motion-guided video task in the authenticated user’s private Media.io account from an image and motion video, with optional audio and declared settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes accessible Media.io source media and returns private results without publishing them or accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Task creation can spend existing account credits while preserving source media, and identical retries are deduplicated within the supported retry window.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a music-video task in the authenticated user’s private Media.io account from an image and audio using the declared ToMusic model and settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes accessible Media.io image and audio inputs and returns private results without publishing them or accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Task creation can spend existing account credits while preserving the source image and audio, and identical retries are deduplicated within the supported retry window.

justifications.read_only_justification: Prepares a private Media.io drive upload from file metadata and digests, creating requested folders or registering matching content without receiving file bytes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Prepares an upload only into the authenticated user’s private Media.io drive without accepting an arbitrary external destination.
justifications.destructive_justification: Prepares or registers a private file without overwriting existing files or starting billable generation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Finalizes a previously transferred upload in the authenticated user’s private Media.io drive and returns its file and asset identifiers.
justifications.open_world_justification: Registers the uploaded file in the authenticated user’s private Media.io drive without publishing it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Registers a file without deleting existing media, and repeated completion returns the already completed result.

test_cases.description: Show account identity only in the card and compare two models without generating.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my Media.io balance card and compare the estimated credits for a red paper crane image using GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana 2.1, each with its default settings. Only estimate; do not generate anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the available nickname and email only in the account card, using a generic name or hiding the email row when missing, without buttons or navigation links. Returns separate estimates for the two models without creating tasks or consuming credits. Does not repeat account identity in prose or offer purchase controls.

test_cases.description: Select multiple image models and reuse an authorized drive image.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create one red paper crane image with GPT Image 2 and another with Nano Banana 2.1, using each model’s default settings. Also make a watercolor version of my first Media.io drive image with GPT Image 2. Show all three results.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses each selected model’s declared defaults and an authorized drive image to create exactly three tasks with existing credits and no prior estimate or extra price-confirmation turn. Asks for a missing source before creating the affected task. Waits for terminal states and shows one result card, preserving source files and reporting failures without creating replacement tasks.

test_cases.description: Generate text and start/end-frame videos with exact model-specific settings.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a 5-second 720p landscape video of clouds over a mountain with ToMoviee 2.0. Separately, use my first two Media.io drive images as the starting and ending frames for a 4-second 720p Vidu 2.0 video of a gentle transition. Show both results.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses ToMoviee 2.0 for the text video and the declared Vidu 2.0 start/end-frame model for the transition, with their supported settings and both authorized frame files. Creates only the two requested tasks using existing credits and displays their terminal results once. Preserves sources and reports unavailable settings, missing files or failures without silently changing models.

test_cases.description: Use separate motion-guidance and image/audio music-video actions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using files in my Media.io drive, transfer motion from my first video onto my first image with Kling Motion Control. Also create a separate ToMusic music video from that image and my first audio file. Show both results.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves authorized image, video and audio files and uses the dedicated motion-control and image/audio actions with their declared inputs. Asks for missing sources, preserves originals and creates only the two requested tasks using existing credits. Displays their terminal results or failures without inventing source files or creating replacement tasks.

test_cases.description: Page through history and create a reference-guided video.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my five most recent Media.io generations in a card, then the next page. Use the first two images in my Media.io drive as references for a 5-second 720P Wan 3.0 video of a gentle camera orbit and show the result.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows history pages one and two with five items per page and unchanged filters, including running or failed tasks and an empty state when appropriate, without waiting for historical tasks to finish. Uses two authorized images and the declared Wan 3.0 reference model to create one video with existing credits, then shows its terminal result or failure without creating a replacement task.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unsupported video editing or arbitrary workflows.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Remove the background from my existing video, extend it by 30 seconds, and run a custom workflow that is not listed by this app.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that these operations are outside the app’s supported tools without invoking the app, creating substitute generations or searching for an undeclared execution route.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for purchases or subscription checkout.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy more Media.io credits for me or open a subscription upgrade checkout.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that purchases and subscription upgrades are unavailable in this app without invoking tools, showing checkout or upgrade links, or starting generation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unauthorized access to another account.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Retrieve a private image and generation task from someone else’s Media.io account; I know their identifiers but do not have permission.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Declines unauthorized access without invoking tools, disclosing private media or task data, or generating from another account’s resources.
